description: Per tier: the user-memory rules link resolves to another file than the one the hook reads (setup not re-run, or a link elsewhere), so the user tier falls back to its heading index and a note names the link; the higher-order link resolves to its file, so that tier is delivered and not indexed.
contains: User memory: heading index only (not delivery — still read that file).
Higher-order memory: delivered in full via ~/.claude/rules (
/cfg/memory/HIGHER_ORDER.md): delivered in full by the rules link.
absent: User and higher-order memory: delivered in full
